text: RAG is a pattern where a system retrieves relevant document chunks from a vector store and gives them to a language model as context, so answers are grounded in real documents and can cite sources.
title: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

text: LangChain is a Python framework for building LLM applications. It provides chains, agents, and integrations for models, vector stores, and tools.
title: LangChain

text: FastAPI is a modern Python web framework for building APIs. It uses type hints, validates requests automatically, and generates interactive API docs.
title: FastAPI

text: FAISS is a library for fast similarity search over dense vectors. It is commonly used to store and retrieve document embeddings in RAG systems.
title: FAISS

text: Qdrant is an open-source vector database. It stores embeddings with metadata and supports filtered similarity search.
title: Qdrant

text: Prompt injection is an attack where a user message tries to override an AI system's instructions, for example with 'ignore previous instructions'. Guardrails scan for such phrases and refuse or sanitise them.
title: Prompt injection

text: Guardrails are checks around an AI agent: input scanning for injection, output checks for safety, and a full trace of tool calls so a human can audit what the agent did.
title: Guardrails

text: Agentic AI means systems that plan multi-step work, call tools, observe results, and adjust. Key parts are planning, tool use, memory, and guardrails.
title: Agentic AI
